why.title: No Midnight wallet could be found for Firefox, although the docs list one
Lace on Firefox cannot set up a Midnight wallet
City agents are asked to hold NIGHT, with no route to register a wallet
The CLI's connector needs a terminal to approve writes, and re-syncs on every start
Contract deploys time out at 100% sync on a wallet that can transfer

found.title: The official packages load two copies of the ledger, and deploys fail
No shielded address can be parsed after a dependency's minor release
DUST registration succeeds, then reports failure
The token metadata spec exists, but nothing serves it on preview

features.title: Valued like a real treasury
features.body: Balances in dollars, not just token counts. NIGHT is priced live, your own tokens at the prices you set, and every figure says it is simulated until mainnet.
points: Your own prices for your own tokens
The same totals for every person and agent
features.alt: Settings: the live NIGHT price from CoinGecko, a fallback price, and a price for each of the organisation's own tokens

features.title: One key in charge
features.body: The operator holds the master key. Launching an agent takes four steps: fund it, register it for fees, appoint it to the treasury, give it a session.
points: New agent wallets made on your machine
A checklist per agent, not a manual
Treasury pause and revoke-all in one place
features.alt: The operator view: the master key card with NIGHT, DUST and addresses, and a setup checklist for each agent

features.title: Limits an agent cannot talk its way past
features.body: Spending caps, the contracts an agent may call and the addresses it may never pay are checked before anything is signed. Treasury limits go further: the contract itself enforces them.
points: Private treasury terms, checked in zero knowledge
features.alt: An agent's page: its balances, spending limits, the contracts it may call, its private treasury terms and its sessions

features.title: A record you can search
features.body: Every request from every wallet, with who asked, which rule decided it and the transaction it became. Filter it, search it, approve from it.
points: Refused requests never reach your queue
Each entry links to the public explorer
Search by agent, contract or transaction
features.alt: The activity log with search, status filters and a list of confirmed treasury and metadata requests

features.title: Issue any kind of token
features.body: Public or private, as coins or as balances inside a contract, fungible or one of a kind. Deploy, mint, convert between private and public, and publish metadata without leaving the app.
points: Built on the latest token proposals
features.alt: The tokens view: contract cards for each token type with mint, NFT, burn and metadata actions and their token lists

hero.title: The wallet for teams that run AI agents
hero.body: One private treasury for your people and your agents. Every agent gets its own wallet, its own limits and its own sessions, and nothing leaves a wallet without a rule or a person saying yes.

phone.alt: The dashboard on a phone, with the tab bar at the bottom
Deploying a token on a phone: a bottom sheet with the four token types

controls.title: Spending caps
controls.body: What an agent may pay without asking, per payment and per day.

controls.title: Whitelisted contracts
controls.body: The only contracts an agent may call.

controls.title: Blocked addresses
controls.body: Payees no agent may reach, also written into the treasury contract.

controls.title: Sessions
controls.body: Tokens that expire, with their own budget of requests and NIGHT.

controls.title: Private caps
controls.body: Each agent's cap per draw, committed in its mandate and proven on every draw.

controls.title: Revoke all
controls.body: One transaction ends every mandate; re-appoint the agents you keep.

multisig.title: Shared control is next
multisig.body: Today one operator key approves what agents cannot do alone. Next, approvals can take a quorum: of people, of agents, or of both.

items.title: Operators together
items.body: Two of three people approve a large payment or a new agent.

items.title: Agents that co-sign
items.body: An agent's spend clears when a second agent agrees, within limits people set.

items.title: Mixed quorums
items.body: An agent proposes, another checks, a person has the final say above a threshold.

multisig.note: Planned, not built. The treasury's anonymous mandates are the starting point: a quorum is a set of mandates that must all prove the same request.

audiences.title: Game studios
audiences.body: Pay the agents that run in your worlds, and keep their spending inside the rules of the game.

audiences.title: Treasuries and DAOs
audiences.body: Give working groups and their agents budgets that the chain enforces, without publishing who holds which budget.

audiences.title: Agent platforms
audiences.body: Hand each agent a wallet and a session, and let people step in only when a rule says so.

run.label: Get the code
run.command: git clone https://github.com/Moddable-Games/moddable-midnight && cd moddable-midnight && npm install
